fire:
Ingredients:
- 2 cups cooked rice
- 1 tablespoon soy sauce
- 3 green onions, sliced

For the dressing:
1/4 cup lemon juice
2 teaspoons honey
1 clove garlic, minced

You will need:
- 8 ounces dried pasta
- 1 cup grated cheese
- 2 cups milk

Salsa:
3 ripe tomatoes, diced
1/2 cup chopped cilantro
1 small red onion, finely chopped

Batter:
- 1 1/2 cups flour
- 2 tablespoons sugar
- 1 cup buttermilk

Soup base:
4 cups chicken stock
1 cup diced celery
2 medium carrots, peeled

Topping:
- 1/2 cup rolled oats
- 3 tablespoons butter
- 1/4 cup brown sugar

Marinade:
2 tablespoons olive oil
1 teaspoon cumin
1/2 cup plain yogurt
quiet: Rice and soy sauce are staples in many kitchens across East Asia.
Lemon juice and honey make a soothing drink when you have a cold.
Pasta with cheese is the dish my kids ask for every single night.
Tomatoes and cilantro grow well together in a sunny backyard garden.
Flour and sugar prices went up again at the market this month.
Chicken stock is easy to make if you save the bones after dinner.
Oats and butter were the only things left in the cupboard on Friday.
Olive oil and yogurt are common in cooking around the Mediterranean.
